candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, ~2s), causing order to return 502 and gateway /v1/checkout to fail with 502 at ~2s; payment p95 latency is ~4875ms while its own requests still return 200.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment server-side p95 is high but its requests succeed; the exact cause of payment slowness (internal saturation vs dependency) is not established by current evidence.

report.explanation: Traces show order->payment POST /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout while inventory/redis succeed, and gateway/order 502s at ~2s. Payment metrics show elevated p95 (~4875ms) with 200s, consistent with downstream latency at payment. Redis timeout and db-pool causes are not supported by current evidence.
